jobs.title: Community & Traveler Experience Intern at GoSkyHy
jobs.description: Employer: GoSkyHy Expires: 10/03/2026 GoSkyHy Community & Traveler Experience InternWhere Adventures Begin — and where every traveler feels like they've found theirpeople.Location: Remote + your campus | Commitment: ~10 hrs/week, one semester |Compensation: $1,337/month flat — same in every country (≈$30+/hour at ~10hrs/week) + performance bonuses | Academic credit: Supported — arranged byyou through your university; we'll complete any employer paperworkWho We AreGoSkyHy is the social travel platform where people connect, create groups, andbook unique adventures around the world. We help people find hidden gems, jointravel crews, and turn "someday" trips into this-weekend plans. An app can getsomeone to download — but community is what makes them stay. That's yourdepartment.The GigYou'll be the heartbeat of the GoSkyHy community — the reason new users feelwelcomed instead of lost.Bring the community to life. Seed and moderate travel groups, welcome newmembers, spark conversations, and connect travelers who should obviously be onthe same trip. You set the vibe of the platform.Grow our host network. Find and recruit the people running amazing local events— hikes, food tours, hidden-gem adventures — and help them get set up asGoSkyHy hosts.Be the voice of the traveler. Talk to users, gather feedback, spot the frictionpoints, and bring it all to the founding team. Your insights will directly shape theproduct — yes, the team will actually read them.You Might Be Our Person If...You're the friend who makes sure nobody eats lunch alone. You reply to groupchats first and remember everyone's name at the party. You're studyinghospitality, psychology, communications, business — or none of the above,because warmth and hustle beat any major. Bonus points if you've ever run a club,moderated a Discord, or planned a trip for more than four people without agroup falling apart.The Pay$1,337 every month. Yes, really. A flat monthly rate, the same whether you're inTexas, London, Sydney, or Singapore — at roughly 10 hours a week, that's over$30/hour. For context: the average US marketing internship pays $17.66/hour. Wepay elite rates because we expect elite work.Community bonuses. We set milestones together — active travel groups, hostsonboarded, insights shipped — and hitting them earns cash bonuses on top ofyour monthly rate.A raise for coming back. Crush your first semester and get invited for a second?Your monthly rate goes up.Paid monthly, on time, every time. Real payments, real records — this is a job, nota favor.Based on approximately 10 hours per week. Hours are agreed and tracked so youreffective hourly rate always exceeds your local minimum wage.What You Get (a.k.a. Why This Beats a Boring Internship)Real product influence. Your user research and feedback reports go straight tothe founders. "That feature exists because of my insight" is a rare thing to say asan intern anywhere.A community you built. The travel groups you seed, the hosts you recruit, theusers you welcome — that's a measurable, portfolio-ready story about growingand running a real community.Direct access to founders. Weekly sessions with the GoSkyHy team — no middlemanagers, no busywork. You'll learn community-building, user research, andproduct thinking from the inside.Academic credit. Want course credit on top of the paycheck? It's yourresponsibility to arrange it with your university — every school's process isdifferent — but once you do, we'll gladly complete any employer paperwork,evaluations, or supervisor sign-offs your program requires.A recommendation letter from the CEO. Crush it, and you'll have a personalizedletter — and a reference who picks up the phone when recruiters call.A title that works for you. "Community & Traveler Experience Intern, GoSkyHy" onyour LinkedIn and resume from day one.First shot at paid roles. As GoSkyHy grows, our intern alumni are first in line.The Fine PrintThis is a part-time, paid internship designed around your learning: you'll set goalswith us, get mentorship and feedback, and build a portfolio — all on a schedulethat flexes around exams. One semester, with the option to continue.How to ApplySkip the cover letter. Send us:1. Your resume2. A few sentences on the best adventure you've ever had3. A community you've been part of (or built) and what made it work4. One idea for making new GoSkyHy users feel instantly at homeEmail: partners@goskyhy.com | www.goskyhy.com

As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?Transform the everyday with us!Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? jobs.title: Westfield Summer Intern at Westfield
jobs.description: Employer: Westfield Expires: 10/04/2026 About UsFounded in 1848, Westfield is a global leader in property and casualty insurance, delivering superior risk insights and innovative solutions to customers through a diverse portfolio of insurance products. Westfield underwrites commercial, personal, surety, and specialty lines of coverage through a network of leading independent agents and brokers in the United States and specialty products through Lloyd's of London Syndicate 1200. As a mutual insurance company with more than 3,000 employees, Westfield has revenues in excess of $4 billion and more than $10 billion in assets.Summer Internship ProgramAt Westfield, our interns are active contributors, not observers. Through meaningful projects, professional development opportunities, and collaboration with experienced professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience while making an impact across the business.Our Summer Internship Program provides opportunities to explore careers in insurance, technology, analytics, finance, human resources, communications, and other business functions. Throughout the summer, interns build professional skills, grow their networks, and gain valuable insight into how a leading property & casualty insurance company serves its customers, agents, and communities.What You'll ExperienceAs a Westfield Intern, you may:Contribute to meaningful projects that support business goals and strategic initiatives.Collaborate with professionals and leaders across the organization.Develop technical, analytical, and professional skills through real-world work experiences.Participate in networking events, learning sessions, and professional development opportunities.Gain exposure to the insurance industry and the many career paths it offers.Present your work and recommendations to business leaders and stakeholders.Internship Opportunities ActuarialActuarial Interns support key insurance functions including pricing, reserving, predictive modeling, and data analysis. Interns work alongside experienced actuaries to solve business problems, analyze trends, and help drive data-informed decisions that support Westfield's success.ClaimsClaims Interns gain exposure to the claims process and how Westfield delivers exceptional service to customers during important moments. Interns may assist with claim investigations, data analysis, process improvement initiatives, and projects that support operational excellence.CommunicationsCommunications Interns help tell Westfield's story through internal and external communications, content creation, employee engagement initiatives, and digital communication strategies. Interns gain experience supporting programs that strengthen relationships with employees, customers, agents, and communities.Data Analytics & ReportingData Analytics & Reporting Interns work with data, reporting tools, and business stakeholders to deliver insights that support decision-making. Interns gain experience analyzing information, identifying trends, and helping transform data into meaningful business outcomes.Data ScienceData Science Interns support the development of analytical and predictive solutions that address real-world business challenges. Interns work with large data sets, explore emerging analytical techniques, and help generate insights that influence strategic decision-making.Finance & AccountingFinance & Accounting Interns gain experience supporting financial operations, reporting, analysis, budgeting, and business planning activities. Interns develop a deeper understanding of how financial information supports organizational performance and strategic decision-making.Government RelationsGovernment Relations Interns gain exposure to legislative, regulatory, and public policy issues impacting the insurance industry. Interns may research emerging topics, monitor industry developments, and support initiatives that help advance Westfield's business objectives.Human ResourcesHuman Resources Interns support initiatives related to talent acquisition, employee experience, learning and development, compensation, benefits, and organizational effectiveness. Interns gain hands-on experience helping create a positive and engaging workplace culture.Information SecurityInformation Security Interns assist with efforts to protect Westfield's systems, data, and digital assets. Interns gain exposure to cybersecurity practices, risk management, threat monitoring, and initiatives designed to strengthen the organization's security posture.Information TechnologyInformation Technology Interns work with technology professionals to support systems, applications, infrastructure, and digital solutions that enable business success. Interns gain practical experience applying technology to solve business challenges and improve user experiences.Internal AuditInternal Audit Interns help evaluate business processes, internal controls, and risk management practices across the organization. Interns learn how organizations identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen controls, and support effective governance.Risk ControlRisk Control Interns partner with professionals who help organizations identify, assess, and mitigate risk. Interns gain exposure to risk management strategies, safety practices, loss prevention activities, and customer-focused consulting services.What We're Looking ForCurrently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited college or university.Strong academic performance and a desire to learn.Effective communication and collaboration skills.Ability to think critically, solve problems, and take initiative.Interest in gaining real-world business experience through a challenging and rewarding internship.Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.Why WestfieldAt Westfield, you'll do meaningful work, build valuable professional relationships, and gain experience that helps prepare you for future career opportunities. We're committed to creating a supportive environment where interns can learn, contribute, and grow.Behavioral Competencies:CollaboratesCommunicates EffectivelyCustomer FocusDecision QualityNimble LearningThis job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

Offices close at 1 p.m. on Friday.You don’t have to stress about getting to your new city or where you’re going to live. Summer relocation and housing is provided by Conagra as needed.Summer Send Off. Come back to Omaha to celebrate and give back to the community. Is this internship right for you?We're looking for someone who wants to be part of promoting the most energized, highest impact culture in the food industry. jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Analytics Intern (Summer 2027) at DriveTime Family of Brands
jobs.description: Employer: DriveTime Family of Brands Expires: 10/04/2026 What’s Under the Hood DriveTime Family of Brands is the largest privately owned used car sales finance & servicing company in the nation. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona and Dallas, Texas, we create opportunities and improve the lives of our customers and our employees by placing a focus on putting the right customer, in the right vehicle, on the right terms and on their path to ownership.The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle. That’s Nice, But What’s the Job? This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time. We are looking for Data Analytic Interns who possess a strong understanding of analytics and data principles for our Summer 2027 internship program. DriveTime Family of Brands is a highly data driven organization with several analytic departments. Our data analytics interns could support one of the following verticals: Credit Risk & Pricing Analytics, Loan Servicing Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Retail Analytics and SilverRock Analytics. A successful candidate should have knowledge of data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau and Excel. Above all, the candidate should have a passion for uncovering actionable insights from data. The analytic interns will be responsible for things like:Conducting data analysis to generate meaningful insights from data setsBrainstorm ideas and provide creative solutions to challenges in data analysisParticipate in all phases of the analytic lifecycle, from research design, data collection and data processing to model building, deployment, and presentation of results.Innovate existing products and services while using technologies and data analysts to identify new opportunities to improve customer experience and profitability.Provide ad hoc analysis and special projects as required. So what are we looking for?Killer analytics and reporting abilities. You’ll need the capability to analyze data and in return, prepare timely reports on your findings.A mind for the details. Okay, we know “detail-oriented” is on about every job description – but we really mean it!Fantastic problem solver. Your job is not only to find the problem, but more importantly, find the solution.Agile in a fast-paced environment. We move, and we move quickly. Thriving in an environment that never stops, is a must.Intellectual curiosity. Why? What? How? Do you find yourself always wanting to learn more and broaden your knowledge base? If so, this could be the role for you!Excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to talk and write with confidence, charisma and competence for a wide variety of audiences including management. The Specifics.Bachelors or Master’s student with a graduation date between December 2027 – May 2028Pursuing a quantitative degree in Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or other STEM fieldsYou have a GPA of 3.5 or higherData analysis experienceWorking knowledge in SQL, Python, Tableau and ExcelOur internship program is 11 weeks starting May 2027 – August 2027Internships will be base out of our Home offices in Tempe, AZ and Dallas, TXYou can expect a regular on-site schedule; Monday-Friday, 40 hours per weekRelocation not provided for internship So What About the Perks? Perks matter.Not Just Coffee Runs. We’re talking real world experience. You’ll walk away from our internship program with hands-on experience, completed projects, full portfolios, and newly developed skills.Who Says You Have to Walk Away? Across both our Tempe, AZ and Dallas, TX offices, over 60% of our interns stay through the fall semester, return the following summer, or are brought on full-time after graduation.Growth & Development. You will be mentored by industry professionals, be given guidance along the way, and the tools to be successful.Philanthropy: Give for Good. We are proud to be difference makers in our communities. We dedicate time for our Interns to give back with us.Gratitude is Green. Out Internship Program is paid, because, well… money matters! Anything Else? Absolutely.DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)! Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

jobs.description: Employer: Nines Group Expires: 10/04/2026 Company OverviewNines Media is a social media marketing firm specializing in brand focused digital campaigns across major platforms. We work closely with restaurant franchises, beauty and skincare brands, lifestyle products, and consumer focused businesses to build long term brand presence through strategic content, short form video, and experiential marketing.Many of the brands and campaigns we support are influenced by Korean culture, including Korean food, beauty, entertainment, and lifestyle trends, while also collaborating with a wide range of diverse brands across multiple industries.In addition to managing digital campaigns, Nines Media directly operates retail locations, pop up events, and brand activations. This role is primarily focused on social media execution, including content planning, filming support, editing, posting, and account management.This paid internship is best suited for recent graduates and early career professionals seeking hands on experience in a professional marketing environment. The position is structured as a long term opportunity, with full time employment frequently offered to high performing interns who demonstrate consistency, growth, and strong alignment with company goals.Primary Responsibilities- Support the creation and execution of social media content for active brand accounts- Assist with content planning, filming days, and campaign preparation- Edit short form video and visual assets for social media platforms- Support posting, scheduling, and general account maintenance- Engage with online audiences to support brand presence and community growth- Collaborate with internal teams during monthly campaigns and themed initiativesAdditional Experience Opportunities- Participation in retail events, pop up activations, and experiential marketing projects- On camera participation for content creation is recommended but not required- Occasional domestic and international travel opportunities, offered based on productivity, performance, and project needs- Professional networking with brand partners, creators, and industry professionalsCandidate Qualifications- Strong interest in social media marketing and digital branding- Familiarity with major social media platforms and current content trends- Professional communication skills and attention to detail- Ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment- Reliability, initiative, and willingness to learnExperience with video editing, creative software, or marketing tools is preferred but not required.Applicants with a strong interest in Korean culture, Korean food, Korean beauty, Korean entertainment, and Korean media trends, as well as those who enjoy working with diverse brands, are likely to find this role especially engaging.Growth and Long Term OpportunityThis internship is designed as a pathway into long term employment. Nines Media prioritizes developing team members who seek stability and professional growth rather than short term internship experience. jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: IT Risk Assurance Intern - Summer 2027 at Sensiba LLP
jobs.description: Employer: Sensiba LLP Expires: 10/04/2026 IT Risk Assurance Interns work closely with Sensiba's project teams across the GRC IT Risk Assurance Service and assist in the planning of audits, the fieldwork testing of the design and operating effectiveness of client IT Management systems & controls. Interns will get exposure to control auditing, control design evaluation, structure/components of Assurance Reports, and common information security auditing frameworks & standards (SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, & HIPPA). This role provides hands on job experience to students interested in pursuing a future career in information security, regulatory compliance, control auditing, and data governance. As a Sensiba intern, you'll join our award-winning internship program, gaining hands-on experience while developing technical and professional skills. A highlight of the program is an on-site week at our San Jose headquarters, featuring immersive training, professional development, and networking with colleagues and firm leaders. jobs.description: Employer: Fastflo Expires: 10/05/2026 Sales Intern (BRD)Fastflo | Remote | Part-time or Full-time | Base + CommissionAbout FastfloFastflo is a VC-backed B2B SaaS startup built at the Harvard Innovation Labs. We're changing how companies hire frontline workers: instead of forcing candidates through clunky web forms, applications happen natively inside iMessage and other messaging apps. The result is that around 80% of candidates finish their application, versus roughly 15% on traditional flows. We recently closed our seed round and count global enterprise brands and multi-location franchise operators among our customers.We're now scaling our sales pipeline, and that's where you come in.The RoleYou will own the very top of our sales engine. We hand you qualified lead lists; your job is to get decision makers on the phone and book meetings for our closing team. You are not selling on these calls, and you're not expected to. Your single goal is simple and measurable: turn a qualified lead into a booked meeting. Our team takes it from there and closes the deal.This is the fastest possible education in startup sales. You'll learn how to open a cold call, handle a brush-off, earn thirty seconds of attention from a busy operator, and convert it into a calendar invite. These are skills that compound for the rest of your career, and you'll build them with direct coaching from our founder and sales leadership, not from the back row of a large sales floor.Booking meetings is where you start, not where you stop. Prove yourself on the phones and your scope grows with you: sitting in on the sales calls you booked, running parts of discovery and demos, and taking on responsibilities across the sales cycle and the wider business. At a startup this size, the people who deliver get handed more, quickly.What You'll DoCold call decision makers from qualified lead lists we provideBook discovery meetings for the closing team and hand off clean contextTrack your outreach and results in our CRMRefine call scripts and openers with the team based on what's actually workingGet direct visibility into how booked meetings turn into closed dealsWhat Success Looks LikeQualified meetings booked. That's the metric. You'll have a clear weekly target, full transparency on your numbers, and commission tied directly to the meetings you put on the calendar.Who Thrives HereCurrently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or master's degreeComfortable picking up the phone and talking to strangers, or genuinely eager to become comfortable fastResilient: you can hear "no" ten times and dial the eleventh number with energyCoachable, organized, and self-directed in a remote environmentNo prior sales experience required. You will be responsible for reviewing contracts and billing requirements, monitoring project budgets, identifying potential change order opportunities, preparing client invoices, coordinating invoice approvals, and ensuring timely and accurate invoice submission. Experience in Business and Accounting. Proficient in Excel. Your work will help maintain strong client relationships, support project profitability, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.Core ResponsibilitiesCore Responsibilities exist to provide clarity and direction. They ensure you understand your essential duties and the expectations of your role.As a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you will manage the contract review and client invoicing process for environmental consulting projects. You will review contracts and billing requirements, monitor project budgets and billing status, identify potential change order opportunities, prepare draft invoices, coordinate project manager review and approval, and submit finalized invoices to clients. You will maintain accurate billing records, support project financial management efforts, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and company procedures. You will work closely with project managers, accounting staff, and leadership to support efficient project delivery and financial performance.ActivitiesYou will perform the following activities regularly to support your Core Responsibilities.Review client contracts, task orders, purchase orders, and amendments to determine billing requirements and invoicing schedulesMaintain accurate records of contract terms, billing provisions, project budgets, and contract ceilingsMonitor project budgets, labor utilization, expenses, and billing statusReview project phases for budget overruns prior to invoice preparationNotify project managers when project phases exceed budgeted amounts and discuss potential causesIdentify situations where project scope may have exceeded contractual requirements and recommend review for potential change orders or contract amendmentsPrepare accurate draft invoices and supporting documentation for environmental consulting projectsSubmit draft invoices to project managers for review and approvalIncorporate revisions and finalize invoices for client submissionDistribute approved invoices in accordance with client requirements and contractual deadlinesMaintain organized invoice records, billing documentation, and project financial filesAssist with responding to client and internal inquiries regarding billing, contract requirements, and invoice statusSupport weekly and monthly project financial reviews and reporting activitiesCollaborate with project managers and accounting staff to improve billing efficiency, accuracy, and contract complianceMaintain flexibility to support changing project, client, and organizational needsCore Values AlignmentOur Core Values are listed below, including examples illustrating how someone in the role acts.Be AuthenticAs a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you embody authenticity by communicating openly and professionally with project managers, accounting staff, clients, and leadership. You build trust through transparency, accuracy, and consistency in your work. You address billing and contract concerns directly and professionally while maintaining positive working relationships and representing the company with integrity.Take InitiativeAs a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you demonstrate initiative by proactively monitoring project budgets, contract limits, and billing schedules. You identify potential issues before they become problems, communicate concerns regarding budget overruns or scope changes, and seek solutions that support project success and financial performance. You take ownership of the invoicing process from contract review through final invoice submission.Raise the BarAs a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you are committed to producing accurate, timely, and contractually compliant invoices. You maintain a high level of attention to detail, continuously improve processes, and strive to enhance efficiency and quality in all aspects of project billing and contract administration. You actively seek opportunities to improve workflows and support organizational growth.Iron Sharpens IronAs a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you strengthen the team by collaborating effectively with project managers, technical staff, accounting personnel, and leadership. You share knowledge, support team members, and contribute to a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. You value constructive feedback and recognize that strong collaboration leads to better project outcomes.Finish StrongAs a Project Billing & Contracts Coordinator, you remain committed to seeing projects through every stage of the billing process. You ensure invoices are reviewed, approved, and submitted on schedule while maintaining accuracy and compliance. You follow through on outstanding issues, communicate proactively regarding challenges, and remain focused on achieving successful project and financial outcomes.MeasurablesUnderstanding how we measure performance for this role is critical to your success. Here are the metrics that align with the Core Responsibilities.Prepare and submit all invoices accurately and within established billing deadlinesMaintain contract compliance and billing accuracy on all assigned projectsIdentify and communicate project budget overruns or potential scope issues before invoice issuanceNotify project managers of budget concerns, billing discrepancies, or potential change order opportunities within 24 hours of discoveryMaintain organized, accurate, and up-to-date contract files, invoice records, and supporting documentationAchieve less than 2% invoice correction or reissue rate due to billing errorsConsistently follow company billing procedures, contract administration protocols, and quality control standardsSupport positive project cash flow through timely invoice preparation and submissionMaintain professionalism, responsiveness, and effective communication with project managers, clients, accounting staff, and leadershipDemonstrate initiative by identifying opportunities to improve billing processes, contract administration procedures, and operational efficiencySuccessfully support project managers in managing project financial performance, contract compliance, and change order tracking

jobs.title: Business Undergraduate Summer Internship at Wellington Management Company LLP
jobs.description: Employer: Wellington Management Company LLP Expires: 10/06/2026 WELLINGTON MANAGEMENTWellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 50 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.Wellington Management is seeking motivated undergraduate students to join our 2027 Business Undergraduate Summer Internship Program. This 10-week paid internship provides hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to the investment management industry. Interns will work full-time (40 hours/week) at our Boston headquarters starting June 2027. Interns are also eligible for a housing stipend and a flexible work model that includes four days per week in the office and one remote workday.This program is designed to help students build professional skills, explore career paths, and contribute to meaningful projects alongside experienced professionals.What You’ll Do: As a summer intern, you will join a team within Wellington’s Client, Investment or Infrastructure platforms and gain exposure to the business functions that support a leading global investment management firm.You may:Support day-to-day team projects and strategic initiativesConduct research, data analysis, and process improvementsCollaborate with teams across the firmWork on a summer project solving a real business challenge At the end of the summer, you will have the opportunity to present your work and insights to senior leaders, mentors, and your peers.Internship OpportunitiesInterns may be placed in one of several business areas that align to intern’s interests, skills and business need. You will have the opportunity to indicate your preferences during the application process. Client Platform – The Client Platform is a global team focused on building and deepening relationships with prospects, clients, and consultants. Working closely with Wellington's investment professionals, the team helps clients navigate complex investment challenges, understand their unique objectives, and identify the investment strategies, portfolios, and solutions best suited to their needs. The platform includes professionals across business development, relationship management, and product management who support a diverse range of institutional investors, including public pension funds, central banks, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, retirement plan sponsors, and mutual fund sponsors. Responsibilities may include analyzing new business opportunities by region or channel, supporting business analytics, conducting competitive analysis and due diligence, engaging with Wellington’s evolving technologies and client-related applications, and helping evaluate investment opportunities. Finance – The Finance team provides financial stewardship and strategic support across Wellington's global business. Through financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, expense management, tax, and corporate finance activities, the team helps guide business decisions, allocate resources, and support the firm's long-term growth. Interns may contribute to financial analysis and modeling, budgeting processes, management reporting, tax research, and other projects that provide insight into how a global investment management firm operates. Global Operations – This function drives the firm's operational edge to exceed the investment and service expectations of our clients worldwide. Working across investment, client, and infrastructure teams, the group designs and executes the processes, controls, and infrastructure that support Wellington's world-class investment strategies and client relationships. The team plays a critical role in supporting client onboarding and servicing, investment activities, operational reporting, and responding to the evolving needs of our global client base. Interns will gain a practical understanding of how operational processes are built to deliver scalability, risk mitigation, service excellence, and a high-quality client experience. Legal, Compliance & Risk – Help the firm operate effectively in a complex regulatory environment with evolving compliance programs, you will contribute to the completion of risk-mitigating projects, and conduct analysis and reporting. Responsibilities may include tagging and analyzing key risk management metrics, gaining proficiencies in regulatory requirements of regimes applicable to a US investment adviser, assisting with due diligence process for new and critical vendors, and assisting with the testing of control design and effectiveness. Investment Implementation & Trading – Opportunity to gain practical experience in the dynamic world of markets and trading. Responsibilities may include supporting the firm’s domestic and international post-execution trade activities, interacting with traders and brokers, and conducting trading data analysis. You will gain a solid foundation in trading and trade confirmation practices associated with today’s global financial markets. You will learn about a variety of markets, the role of trading at Wellington, the trade lifecycle, and how we work with portfolio managers who invest on behalf of our clients. Additionally, you will gain experience in industry applications such as Bloomberg, and CTM. What You’ll GainThroughout the program, interns will:Gain exposure to the investment management industryWork on real projects with business impact and gain in-depth understanding of their functionBuild skills in analysis, communication, and problem solvingMentorship and feedback opportunities that focus on learning and growthParticipate in professional development workshopsNetwork with professionals and fellow internsWho Should ApplyWe welcome students from a broad range of majors, backgrounds and experiences who are interested in learning about business and investment management. We look for:Current sophomore and junior undergraduate students from all academic majors working toward a bachelors degreeStrong communication, attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skillsCurious and adaptable, with an interest in leveraging emerging technologies and AI tools to improve efficiency, enhance decision-making and discover smarter ways of workingInterest in business, finance, or operationsParticipation in on-campus activities, leadership roles, volunteer opportunities and work experiences Ability to work collaboratively in a team environmentNo prior finance experience is required. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Application Deadline: October 2, 2026 JOB TITLEBusiness Undergraduate Summer Internship LOCATION280 Congress Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.About this positionThe IDB Group is looking for an active graduate student to be hired as an intern under the Consultant modality. The 2027 Winter Internship Program is a competitive paid opportunity, based in Headquarters, for university students from member countries to learn about development work and corporate management of the Bank, and to acquire work experience at the professional level through on-the-job learning.The Institutional Capacity of the State Division (ICS) is seeking a graduate intern to support its Transparency and Integrity thematic area in developing an innovative, web-based analytical tool for Latin America and the Caribbean. The assignment will contribute to the Bank’s efforts to strengthen evidence-based policy dialogue and operational engagement on transparency, integrity, financial integrity, and state effectiveness.Building off the team’s existing diagnostic tools, the intern will develop a working proof of concept for an interactive regional dashboard that brings together internationally recognized indicators and secondary evidence on countries’ transparency and integrity systems. The tool will organize information across three analytical dimensions: enabling conditions, institutional capacity, and risk management. It will allow users to explore country profiles, compare selected countries and indicators, examine trends, and access the underlying sources and methodological information.The dashboard will also support the production of Country Integrity Snapshots, concise analytical briefs that synthesize the available evidence into accessible country-level profiles. The assignment will draw on the team’s existing analytical work, remain distinct from a full diagnostic assessment.The internship offers an opportunity to combine applied data science, interactive visualization, and institutional analysis in a practical development context. The successful candidate will work with Bank specialists to translate an existing analytical concept into a functional prototype that can demonstrate the value of integrated country evidence and provide a foundation for potential future development.What you’ll doCompile, validate, and structure the agreed international indicators and secondary evidence for selected countries, including source metadata, definitions, and methodological limitations.Develop a working web dashboard proof of concept that enables interactive exploration of country profiles, selected indicators, trends, and cross-country comparisons.Integrate source documentation and develop functionality to generate or export standardized Country Integrity Snapshots from the underlying data.Prepare concise, evidence-based interpretations of country patterns and demonstrate how the tool can support regional analysis, policy dialogue, and further country-level assessment.Deliver the functional prototype, supporting data and code, technical documentation, and a final demonstration with recommendations for potential future development.What you'll needEducation: An active graduate student (master’s or Ph.D.) student in Data Science, Computer Science, Computational Social Science, Statistics, Economics, Public Policy, International Development, Information Systems, or a closely related field from an accredited University. The graduation date should be after the Internship period.Languages: Fluency in English with a working knowledge of one other Bank language (Spanish, French, or Portuguese) is a plus.Key Skills: Learn continuously, collaborate and share knowledge, focus on clients, communicate and influence, innovate and try new thingsSoft Skills: Result-driven, collaborative, innovative, client-oriented, strong communicator, self-motivated, eager to learn, and excellent time management skills.Technical skills: Strong analytical and communication skills, with familiarity with transparency, integrity, anti-corruption, financial integrity, and international development; ability to integrate data from multiple sources and develop user-friendly analytical products, with experience in interactive dashboards, Python or R, and AI-assisted tools desirable.RequirementsCitizenship: Be a national of an IDB member country.Active student: Enrolled in a graduate (master’s or Ph.D.) program as of the starting date of the internship program. In addition, you have not been a former staff member, Complementary Workforce (“CW”), contractor for the Bank or the Corporation, or have previously provided services to the Bank or the Corporation through a contractor or under any other contractual modality.Notes:Submit your resume, academic transcripts (official or unofficial), and university letter certifying your student status when applying.If you submit an unofficial academic transcript at the time of applying, you will be requested to present an official one if moving forward.Academic transcripts and university letters should be issued within the last three months.For graduate students a minimum of 50% of coursework must be completed when applying.Applications without the requested documentation will be disqualified.Save each file in a PDF format with your name and subject.DO NOT send copies of your degree certificates or other courses.You must be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) from January 16th to March 15th, 2027. These dates are fixed and cannot be modified. Interns must complete their assignments within this period.If you are an international student in the U.S.A., your work authorization is through CPT or OPT. Consult your school advisor before applying. You must be able to work 40 hours per week, many international students are limited to working part-time, depending on their academic standing.Type of contract and durationType of contract: Intern ConsultantLength of contract: Two (2) monthsDates of the contract: January 16th to March 15th, 2027Location: Washington, D.C. – United States of America*Internship dates may be adjusted slightly to accommodate holidays.Our cultureAt the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org.About the IDB Group About the IDB Group The IDB Group, composed of the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB), IDB Invest, and the IDB Lab offers flexible financing solutions to its member countries to finance economic and social development through lending and grants to public and private entities in Latin America and the Caribbean. About IDB We work to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Through financial and technical support for countries working to reduce poverty and inequality, we help improve health and education and advance infrastructure. Our aim is to achieve development in a sustainable, climate-friendly way. With a history dating back to 1959, today we are the leading source of development financing for Latin America and the Caribbean. We provide loans, grants, and technical assistance; and we conduct extensive research. We maintain a strong commitment to achieving measurable results and the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability. IDB Invest finances sustainable companies and projects to achieve financial results and maximize economic, social, and environmental development in the region. With a portfolio of $14.1 billion in asset management and 325 clients in 25 countries, IDB Invest provides innovative financial solutions and advisory services that meet the needs of its clients in a variety of industries. jobs.description: Employer: Confluence Environmental Center, AmeriCorps Program Expires: 10/07/2026 Dates of Service October 21st, 2026 – July 29th, 2027 (1,200 hours, approx. 32 hours/week) POSITION TITLEDepave for Trees Coordinator Project PARTNEROregon Walks and Depavehttps://oregonwalks.org/https://www.depave.org/ Position SummaryThis position is in partnership between the Confluence Environmental Center, AmeriCorps Program, DePave and Oregon Walks. 82nd Avenue is in the middle of major public reinvestment, and one of the clearest calls from the community has been for less pavement and more green space, especially trees. This position exists to answer that call on the ground: designing a new "micro-depaving" pilot program that partners directly with private landowners to remove small sections of pavement, plant a tree, and support the landowner in maintaining it. This position will build the relationships and evidence base for a micro-depaving program model through community outreach, education, and partnership building to support increased access to greenspaces along 82nd Avenue.Estimated time breakdown: 40% research, pilot program design; 30% outreach, recruitment, and education; up to 10% project fundraising; and 20% Confluence cohort/leadership development activities. The AmeriCorps Volunteer will participate in Confluence-led leadership development activities which include: Leadership Development Training Series, team meetings, National Service events and other self-directed development opportunities (20%). Essential Functions (to include, but not limited to):Research and design a "micro-depaving" program model for small-scale private-lot depaving projects along the 82nd Avenue corridor including explanations on how to identify sites, how to engage with land owners, how to navigate permitting, and how to contract with partners.Outreach to private landowners along 82nd Avenue to identify potential participantsBuild and maintain relationships with community and technical partners, including the 82nd Avenue Coalition, BRANCH Coalition partners, the City of Portland, and local workforce development organizations.Coordinate with City of Portland permitting staff to understand how the program design stays within permit-exempt thresholds.Identify and define project metrics, outcomes, and narratives to support project sustainability including information about the history of over paving, its impacts on the community, and the importance of depaving and tree canopy development.Complete and submit all necessary paperwork and reports in a timely manner; attend and complete all training and service requirements; wear Confluence uniform and/or appropriate identifiers and required safety gear while performing service or attending official events.Abide by program and AmeriCorps policies. Under no circumstances will AmeriCorps Volunteers be asked to perform prohibited activities outlined in the approved grant. Position RequirementsDeep interest in environmental justice, urban forestry, and environmental work.Comfortable engaging directly with private landowners and community members from a wide range of backgrounds; lived experience in community organizing or outreach is valued equally with formal education.Written and verbal communication skills to draft outreach materials, meeting notes, and grant application materials (specific grant-writing experience is not required but is a benefit).Regular and reliable attendance and dependability; ability to serve as part of a team spanning two host organizations.Willingness/openness to learn about and discuss racial equity and social justice issues.Regular and reliable attendance and dependability. AmeriCorps Volunteers must be: 17 years of age or older at beginning of service term; U.S. citizen, national or lawful permanent resident; in possession of a high school diploma or equivalent, or commit to earning one prior to receiving education award; able to commit to the full term of service; able to successfully pass a fingerprint criminal history background check and satisfactory report from the National Sex Offender Public Website (NSOPW) prior to the start of the position.Ability to serve as part of a diverse team. Preferred QualificationsBilingual or multilingual skills relevant to 82nd Avenue's communities (e.g., Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese).Experience or coursework in urban forestry, landscape design, environmental science, or a related field.Familiarity with East Portland or the 82nd Avenue corridor.Experience with data tracking tools (Excel, Google Sheets) or basic GIS/mapping.Experience organizing or facilitating community events or volunteer work. Member Benefits Include$15,200 living allowance paid over the 8-month term of service (approx. $1,688 monthly, before taxes). $5,176 education award (qualified student loans and/or education expenses) Loan Forbearance Health Care InsuranceChild Care Reimbursement Option$50 Training Fund Professional Leadership Certificate, Trainings and Networking opportunities. May be eligible for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).Monthly TriMet passes available.Access to a Member Assistance Program (free counseling, health & financial tips, etc.)Access to a large network of partner organizationsAccess to events, networking, professional development, and conferencesThe knowledge that you’re working on important environmental justice issues facing tens of thousands of folks in east Portland Project Location & Transportation InformationMember’s office space will be at Depave's Portland office located at River Street Studios (820 N River St, Portland OR) in Portland's inner east side. In person organizing/canvassing and site visits will largely occur on/near 82nd Avenue.Portland has a robust public transit network between the office space and 82nd Avenue. The member is encouraged to utilize public transportation and bicycle transportation. Trimet but and Max routes can be found here.
